items.title: 7.7 Microwaves se stationary waves ka tajruba (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.7 with Fig. 7.10 and the microwave-oven box (PDF 156).

blocks.text: Microwaves electromagnetic radiation ki ek qism hain. Inhein "micro" waves is liye kehte hain ke in ki wavelength aam taur par millimetres ya centimetres jitni hoti hai, jo radio waves se bohat chhoti hai. Stationary (standing) waves microwaves se tab banti hain jab microwaves kisi khaas jagah ya cavity (khokhli jagah), jaise wave guides ya resonant chambers, mein band hon. In ke andar microwaves aage peeche takrati (bounce karti) hain aur nodes aur antinodes wala standing wave pattern banta hai. Aisa tab hota hai jab microwave ki frequency cavity ki resonant frequency ke barabar ho.

blocks.alt: Khula darwaza microwave oven. Labels: Magnetron produces microwaves (oopar baen), Metal wave-guide (oopar ke sath), Rotating stirrer (oopar daen), Food on turntable (neeche), Metal box to keep microwave inside, aur Window has fine metal mesh over it (darwaze par). Laal teer andar takrati microwaves dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Structure of Microwave Oven (PDF page 156): magnetron, wave-guide, stirrer, turntable par khana, dhaat ka dabba aur khirki (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnetron microwaves banata hai; wave-guide unhein dabbe tak le jata hai; stirrer unhein bikherta hai. Dhaat ki deewarein aur khirki ki bareek jaali microwaves ko andar rakhti hain, aur andar stationary waves ban jati hain; turntable khane ko ghumata hai taake nodes par thanda na rahe.
Microwaves se stationary waves neeche diye gaye saada tareeqe se banai ja sakti hain, jaisa Fig. 7.10 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf horn wala microwave source daen taraf metal reflector ki taraf lehrein bhejta hai; darmiyan thos aur dashed curves stationary wave dikhate hain. Beech mein stand par probe detector hai jo CRO se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.10: Microwave se stationary waves ka tajrubati intezam (kitab ki Figure 7.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reflector se palatne wali lehar aane wali lehar se mil kar stationary wave banati hai; metal reflector par node banta hai. Probe ko line ke saath chalayein to CRO par signal antinode par sab se tez aur node par zero hota hai. Do lagataar antinodes ka faasla λ/2 hai, is liye wavelength = 2 × (antinode se agle antinode ka faasla).

Is tajurbe ke set up mein ek microwave source (transmitter), ek probe detector aur ek metal reflector (microwaves ko reflect karne wali metal ki plate) hote hain. Teeno ek hi seedh (line) mein rakhe jate hain.

Microwave source se nikalne wali waves metal plate ki taraf jati hain aur wahan se reflect ho kar wapas aati hain. Reflected wave aur incident (aane wali) wave superpose ho kar stationary wave pattern banati hain. Ise transmitter aur metal plate ke darmiyan rakhe probe detector se pakra ja sakta hai; detector signal ki intensity (shiddat) dikhata hai. Plate ya detector ko khiska kar antinode aur node dekhe ja sakte hain. Ek antinode se agle antinode ka faasla naap kar stationary wave ki wavelength nikali ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: ek antinode se agle antinode ka faasla λ/2 hota hai (aadhi wavelength). Is liye naapa hua faasla 2 se multiply karein to wavelength milti hai: λ = 2 × (antinode se antinode ka faasla).

blocks.prompt: Microwave tajrube mein padosi (agle) antinodes 1.4 cm door milte hain; wavelength aur frequency kya hai? Microwaves ki aam frequency range kya hai (MCQ 7.10)?
blocks.explanation: Padosi antinodes aadhi wavelength door hote hain, to λ = 2 × 1.4 = 2.8 cm = 0.028 m, aur f = c/λ = (3 × 10⁸)/0.028 ≈ 1.1 × 10¹⁰ Hz. Microwaves ki frequency taqreeban 10⁹ Hz se 10¹¹ Hz ke darmiyan hoti hai, option (d).

items: Microwaves electromagnetic waves hain; wavelength millimetres se centimetres.
Cavity ya wave guide mein band ho kar yeh standing waves (nodes aur antinodes) banati hain.
Tajruba: microwave source, probe detector aur metal reflector ek line mein; aane wali aur reflected waves stationary wave banati hain.
Do lagataar antinodes ka faasla λ/2; is se λ nikalti hai.
